{{nihongo|'''Samugawa Shrine'''|寒川神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shimōsa Province]].

'''Samugawa Shrine''' (さむかわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Chūō-ku, Chiba|Q1075869|qid=Q1075869|lt=Chūō-ku}}, {{ill|Chiba (city)|Q170616|qid=Q170616}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|Q80011|qid=Q80011}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinai Shōsha}}, and its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former rank}} was village shrine.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*{{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami}}
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Samukawahiko-no-Mikoto}}
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Samukawahime-no-Mikoto}}

=== Origin ===
The founding date is unknown, but the Samugawa Shrine of {{ill|Shimōsa Province|Q1053695|qid=Q1053695}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' is identified with this shrine. Since old times it has been worshipped as a deity of maritime safety. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it possessed a 10-koku shuin estate.

=== Cultural properties ===
* Mihama-kudari rite of Samugawa Shrine: {{ill|Chiba City regional cultural property|Q60997323|qid=Q60997323}} (category: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=intangible folk cultural property}}). This is the sea procession rite held in the festival below<ref>[http://www.city.chiba.jp/kyoiku/shogaigakushu/bunkazai/samukawamihama.html Chiba City] - accessed September 2, 2019.</ref>.

=== Festival ===
*August 20-21 (includes mikoshi sea-entry procession)

=== Location ===
*123 Samukawa-chō 1-chōme, Chūō-ku, Chiba, Chiba Prefecture
